description:
FILED s521 (Fable, 2026-10-18 19:0x) from the #3494 umbrella CENSUS (docs/ioc-row-census-s521.md, a read-only Opus agent; Fable re-probed the reproducer on main 81afe6b0 vs perl 5.40.3 before filing).

REPRODUCER (scratchpad rv/newa.pl):
    package F; sub g { $. = ++$main::n } package main; F->g for 1..3;
    print $.;  $. = 7; print $.;  { local $. = 9; print $. }  print $.;
perl 5.40.3: `3 7 9 7`.   PCL main 81afe6b0: `undef undef 9 undef` (only the `local` spelling keeps its value).

MECHANISM (read by the census): cl/pcl-runtime.lisp `%p-dot-set` writes the line number onto `*p-last-read-handle*`'s counter and does nothing when no handle has been read; `%p-dot-get` reads that handle's counter and answers undef without one.  In perl `$.` is a magic SV: with no last-read handle the set still stores the plain value and the get returns it.  IO::Uncompress::Base::getline does `$. = ++ *$self->{LineNo}` (also nextStream / input_line_number / reset) after reading its input with `read()`, which makes no handle current in perl either -- so after every getline loop `is $., N` reads undef in all three modes (file, filehandle, buffer).

FIX SHAPE: a FALLBACK VALUE SLOT in the `$.` magic cell -- the setter writes the slot when no handle is current (and the handle's counter when one is), the getter answers the slot when no handle is current; `p-local-dot` (`local $.`, used by IO::Compress::Base at lines 202 / 1377 / 1394) saves and restores the slot too.  Rule 11: ONE cell, both arms.  Probe BEFORE / AFTER vs perl: the reproducer; `$. = 5` then a `<FH>` read (the handle's counter wins, as perl's "last read handle" rule); `local $.` around an assignment with and without a current handle; `$.` after `close` of the last-read handle (perl: keeps the value until another read).  ACCEPTANCE: the reproducer = perl; IO-Compress one-file runs `tools/run-dist-t.pl --rows ~/.cpan/build/IO-Compress-2.214-0 t/107multi-gzip.t` (and -deflate, -rawdeflate, -zip): the 120 `$. is N` rows per file pass and their 480 blessed rows leave baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv by edit (they cite this task); a guard row in the Pl/t file holding `$.` rows (grep 'input_line_number\|\$\.' Pl/t), inverse FAILS on main; a cl/ change: the sweep.  Scheduled: s521d (after #3516).


=== DONE (s521d, Opus 5.5, 2026-10-18; commit 68a10ccb) === One fallback slot *p-dot-value* beside the handle counter: %p-dot-set writes the handle's counter when one is current, else the slot; %p-dot-get answers the slot when none is; p-local-dot rebinds the slot too (bare `local $.`); `local $. = N` was already a whole-box let and needs nothing.  Reproducer = perl (3 7 9 7); pr/dot.pl: every no-handle line = perl.  Guard Pl/t/fileio-02.t test 30b (perl oracle), FAILS on 68aeebf5.  One-file runs 107multi-gzip / -deflate / -rawdeflate / -zip: 1226 pass / 1 fail each (row 1226 + the 1227-of-1829 PLAN stop = #3494); the 480 `$. is N` rows (120 per file -- they cited #3494 in the baseline) left baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv by edit.  Two PRE-EXISTING divergences with a handle current, filed #3571.
subject: SILENT WRONG: `$. = N` while NO handle has been read is LOST -- `%p-dot-set` stores only on *p-last-read-handle* and `%p-dot-get` answers undef without one; perl keeps the value in the `$.` SV.  IO::Uncompress::Base assigns `$.` after read(): every `is $., N` in IO-Compress 107multi-* reads undef = 480 board rows (two thirds of the #3494 umbrella).  Layer cl, SMALL
